goals: Extend CNM ShapeMap families with BGE-owned geometry while preserving Nibaru-owned material identity and semantics.
Provide Layer, Corner, and Quarter Column geometry for every canonical family without changing accepted Step or Vertical behavior.
Enforce one-source-per-blockspace as a shared BGE compound-geometry contract while keeping geometry orientation independent from canonical material and UV orientation.
scope: Maintain BGE-owned placement, state, rendering, collision, drops, and specialized behavior for generated geometry.

Generate exactly one Layer, one Corner, and one Quarter Column after Step for each of 311 canonical ShapeMap families, preserving deterministic family ordering and guarding every generated BGE role from recursive Nibaru material discovery.

Preserve Layer's six-direction facing, one-through-four 4-pixel thickness, waterlogging, established world geometry, and corrected item projection; provide oriented 16-by-8-by-8 Corners and composing 8-by-16-by-8 Quarter Columns with two terminal diagonal states.
Fund only new blockspace occupancy for every compound BGE geometry; compatible in-place expansion is free, failures are free, and normal breaking returns one canonical source block.
Derive Column occupancy by spatially rotating Step while retaining world-space canonical TOP, SIDE, BOTTOM, axis, pattern, overlay, translucent, and other profile-driven material semantics.

exclusions: Nibaru owns canonical material identity, visual roles, capabilities, transitions, copied settings, and material, pattern, and axis semantics.
CNM ShapeMap remains the canonical material-family and switching mechanism; BGE must not create a competing material registry or selector.
BBB is reference-only; its source and assets are excluded, and BGE has no BBB dependency.
Accepted Step and Vertical behavior and Glazed production behavior remain unchanged except for migration-only path normalization.

dependencies.reason: BGE C55 consumes Nibaru C46 canonical-parent material profiles, visual semantics, and typed DROP_BASE contracts.
Fabric API used by the current C55 build and runtime implementation.
Provides the canonical ShapeMap family and geometry-switching mechanism extended by BGE.
Provides the exact Nibaru C46 material-profile and Layer contract implementation paired with C55.

C55 corrects the Layer item by exactly +3 pixels right and +6 pixels down, generalizes one-source-per-blockspace economy across Layer and Quarter Column, and adds Corner and Quarter Column while separating spatial geometry rotation from canonical material orientation. Accepted BGE C52 and Nibaru C45 remain disabled as the unchanged rollback baseline, and Slot B remains unchanged.
